title: dbdiagram.io
description: Documented public database design tool (Holistics) for the Database Architecture Designer capability area.
body:
dbdiagram.io is a documented database design tool from Holistics. Popular free ERD tool using DBML to design schemas visually and export SQL for major databases.

How it works: It works by rendering the table specification into a CREATE TABLE statement with the declared column types.

Documented uses of this capability area include greenfield application generation, legacy system modernization, API platform design, and continuous testing pipelines.
